points.description: States that bulb A is on because it lies in a closed circuit (complete path) with the battery and closed switch Z, so current can flow through it. Equivalent wording such as 'bulb A is part of a complete circuit with the battery and switch Z' earns the mark.

rubric.notes: Full mark for explaining that bulb A forms a closed path with the battery and closed switch Z, allowing current through it. No mark if the answer only says the bulb is on or refers to switch Y without linking bulb A to a closed path with the battery and switch Z.
